hits.title: The closure of the nonreal roots of bounded-height polynomials is connected exactly at pronic heights
hits.abstract_snippet: Let C_h be the closure of the nonreal roots of integer polynomials with coefficients of modulus at most h. With the nonzero real roots included, the closure is connected at every height; without them, connectedness becomes arithmetic. hits.title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
hits.abstract_snippet: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients. hits.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
hits.abstract_snippet: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. hits.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
hits.abstract_snippet: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. hits.title: Online Graph Coloring: Competitive Ratios Separating Randomized and Deterministic Algorithms
hits.abstract_snippet: We study online coloring, focusing on the competitive ratio. The best previously known results were (1) a lower bound of $Ω(n / \log^2 n)$ for both deterministic and randomized algorithms by Halldórsson and Szegedy (1994), (2) an upper bound of $O(n / \log n)$ for randomized algorithms by Halldórsson (1997), and (3) an upper bound of $O(n / \log \log n)$ for deterministic algorithms by Kawarabayas
